rationale: Exact SQL Server DMV behavior and the `LCK_M_S` symptom cannot be reproduced with the available MySQL-only adapter, but the core mechanism — a blocked insert waiting on locks held by an open transaction on a hot referenced row — can be reproduced at mechanism level with synthetic data and concurrent sessions.
missing_capabilities: SQL Server DMVs such as `sys.dm_exec_requests` and `sys.dm_exec_sessions`
SQL Server-specific wait types and blocker visibility semantics
unmatched_conditions: Exact production index definitions and statistics
